name: Tsukigi
source:
One of Magicain Nova's Peacemakers, a Stargazer-class tactician type who helps manage all the other Peacemakers. Amicable and dependable, Tsukigi manages all of Peacemaker HQ's financial woes begrudgingly. He wishes for a more peaceful, simple life, but it seems almost as if he's denying it from himself.

Tsukigi seems to be hiding some sort of burden, busying himself with work as if to forget about it. Despite his pleasant nature, he almost seems to feel guilty when he's happy. Interacting with Parilyne slowly melts the ice in his heart, but he won't feel fulfilled unless he can save her himself.

[From [url=https://toyhou.se/12614498.tsukigi]official bio[/url]]
